title: Development Tribunal decision 22-020: tenancy alterations; QFES assessed the proposed performance solution as not suitable; several fire engineering report revisions (Thuringowa Central, Townsville)

facts.text: QFES, as building advisory agency, appealed under Planning Act 2016 s 229(1)(a)(ii) a development approval for building work for alterations to an existing tenancy in Thuringowa Central, Townsville.
The approved documents included Fire Engineering Report Revision 1 (dated 11 Oct 2021); QFES advised that the proposed performance solution was assessed as not suitable.
A revised report (Revision 4) was submitted, and a further revision (Revision 5, dated 31 Mar 2022) is referred to.

The material considered included the development application decision notice (9 Dec 2021), an amended decision notice (20 Apr 2022), QFES letters (10 Mar 2022 and 24 Mar 2022) with performance-solution assessments, a certificate of occupancy (27 Apr 2022), and fire engineering reports dated 21 Mar 2022 and 23 Aug 2016.
The assessment manager conceded the appeal after realising an oversight; the referral agency response was a properly made submission.
The tribunal set the decision aside and ordered the assessment manager to remake it within 60 days.
